Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class EvaluationCycle

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.EvaluationCycle
@Entity public class EvaluationCycle extends Object
Entity representing an evaluation cycle within the organization. An evaluation cycle defines a period during which employee evaluations are conducted, with specific start and end dates, and can contain multiple individual evaluations.
